The '''Krayt's Jaw''' was a mountain range located west of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Rowan Delk]] had planned to hike the mountains since he was seventeen.
